title: Genie Agents — Meridian Financial Group lab
description: Meridian Financial Group: a synthetic US investment manager — portfolios, funds, AUM snapshots, flows, performance and holdings across 2.1M clients, 4,500 portfolios and four distribution channels, over two fiscal years. The lab dataset for the Genie Agents course.

small.description: 20M transactions. Enough for everything except the performance work.

large.description: 900M transactions. Only for the performance module, where query time has to be measurable.

notebooks.name: 01_catalog_and_schemas
notebooks.title: 01 · Catalog and schemas
notebooks.intro:
Creates the schemas and the documents volume for the Meridian lab.

The first cell shows which catalog you are working in. Check it before running 02 — everything else lands there.

notebooks.name: 02_dimensions
notebooks.title: 02 · Dimensions
notebooks.intro:
Nine dimensions: dates, asset classes, benchmarks, portfolios, funds, advisors, clients, accounts and FX rates.

Every value derives from `hash()` of the row key rather than `rand()`, and ages anchor to a fixed date rather than today. Your data is therefore byte-identical to everyone else's, which is what lets the checks later in the course compare against a known answer.

notebooks.name: 03_facts
notebooks.title: 03 · Facts
notebooks.intro:
Three fact tables: daily AUM snapshots, client flows, and portfolio returns by period.

It generates {{TXN_COUNT}} flow events plus roughly 35M daily AUM snapshots, and takes well under a minute on a warm serverless warehouse.

Read the row counts it prints at the end. You will be asked about them.

notebooks.name: 04_staging
notebooks.title: 04 · Staging
notebooks.intro:
Two objects that exist in most real lakehouses and that nobody has retired: a 380-column custodian position feed, and a superseded AUM extract still sitting beside its replacement.

They are here because deciding what *not* to point an agent at is part of the job.

notebooks.name: 05_governance
notebooks.title: 05 · Governance
notebooks.intro:
A row filter on advisor coverage region, column masks over the client identifiers, and certification tags.

**Needs privilege** to create functions and ALTER the tables, and the `mfg_*` account groups to exist. If you cannot run it, skip it.

notebooks.name: 06_curated
notebooks.title: 06 · Curated layer
notebooks.intro:
The objects an agent should be pointed at: month-end AUM converted to USD with the discretionary split made explicit, settled flows with the netting spelled out, a client view without identifiers, and four Unity Catalog functions.

**Attempt the curation exercise before running this.** It is the worked answer.

notebooks.name: 07_metric_view
notebooks.title: 07 · Metric view
notebooks.intro: One declaration of AUM, assets under advisement and net flows, with synonyms and formats, so they cannot mean different things in different places.

notebooks.name: 99_validate
notebooks.title: 99 · Validate
notebooks.intro:
Fourteen checks confirming the dataset is complete and behaving as expected. Every row should read PASS.

Read the numbers, not just the verdicts.
